subject: Continuity assertion pack and RTO/RPO artifacts
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@lumenpay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: continuity assertion pack + RTO/RPO artifacts

Marcus / team,

Thanks for taking a look. As part of LumenPay's vendor review we need a consolidated continuity assertion pack from Redwood covering your BCP/DR posture and direct evidence for RTO/RPO for hosted inference services. Specifically we'd like: 
- RTO/RPO matrix by product surface (API, embeddings, streaming) with measured times from the last three drills
- Last DR/failover test results (summary + logs or play-by-play)
- A short excerpt of the on-call runbook that describes failover steps and trigger conditions
- Retention and restore point evidence for backups (snapshot cadence, retention windows)
- Mapping to SOC 2 controls where the DR tests are evidence (or pointer to the control mapping)

We're aiming to complete review by Oct 9. Can you provide an initial packet and a shared Drive link? Also confirm if you can provide an auditor contact for independent validation (our external assessor prefers a named contact).

Attached: lumenpay_questionnaire_v3.docx (questionnaire)

Appreciate it,
Olivia Park
Vendor Security Lead | LumenPay
olivia.park@lumenpay.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity assertion pack + RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a single continuity assertion packet with the artifacts you requested. High-level plan:

- Deliverables (initial package by Oct 5): rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx (measured drill times), bcp_overview_v2.pdf (executive summary), playbook-snapshot-2026.md (runbook excerpt), and a mapping doc tying artifacts to SOC 2 controls.
- Owners: Hannah will pull the drill logs and test summaries; Monica will collect retention and backup evidence and the snapshot manifests; I'll produce the high-level assertion and control mapping.
- Auditor contact: Derek Shaw at CyberGate Advisors (copied below) will act as our external point for any independent validation.

Quick notes on measured values (prelim): API surface: median failover RTO ~ 00:00:35 (35s) under normal load; RPO for application state is near-zero for live KV caches (recoverable session state < 1s using multi-region replication), backups are daily with incremental snapshots every hour for persistent stores. We'll provide the drill logs and scripts so you can validate timing.

I'll upload artifacts to a shared Drive folder and send the link once the packet is assembled. If you need anything sooner (specific query about encryption or KMS ownership), flag it and we'll expedite.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx (excel)]
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@lumenpay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@cybergate-advisors.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity assertion pack + RTO/RPO artifacts

Marcus — this is great, thank you. A few follow-ups before you finalize the packet: 
- Can you include the raw timestamps (or an exported CSV) for the last three drills so our assessor can re-run simple calculations?
- For the hourly incremental snapshots you referenced, please confirm the restoration SLA observed in the last drill (how long did restore take end-to-end for a persisted store from snapshot?).
- Please attach the SOC 2 mapping doc or link to the control mapping in Drive.

Also, please include any DocuSign or attestation language your legal team requires for sharing logs. If Derek will be our auditor contact, please confirm his availability for a 30-min call next week (Oct 11–13).

Thanks again — Oct 9 timeline still works for us but the CSVs would help accelerate validation.

Best,
Olivia
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@lumenpay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@cybergate-advisors.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity assertion pack + RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Olivia — following up with the technical pointers you'll need for the CSVs and restore times.

- Drill exports: I will drop three CSVs (drill-20260412.csv, drill-20260605.csv, drill-20260821.csv) into the shared folder with per-step timestamps. Each row contains event, node id, UTC timestamp, and duration ms. Expect approximate sizes of ~1–3MB per file.
- Restore times: last persisted-store restore (2026-08-21) completed in 00:12:47 measured from snapshot retrieval start to verified application-level consistency. We'll surface the verification checklist used during the test.
- Backups & keys: snapshots are stored encrypted at rest in customer-segregated buckets. Keys are rotated quarterly and managed in AWS KMS with CMKs; critical HSM-backed wrapping keys live in our KMS tenant. We'll include a short KMS attestation (no key material) in the pack.
- Drive links and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1lExample/continuity-artifacts — folder will contain: bcp_overview_v2.pdf, rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx, playbook-snapshot-2026.md, drill-20260412.csv, drill-20260605.csv, drill-20260821.csv, soc2_control_map_2026.pdf.

If Derek wants to validate logs directly, we can grant time-limited viewer access to the export directory and schedule a short walkthrough. 

I'll queue the uploads now; Marcus/Hannah/Monica — please confirm when the Drive folder is populated so we can send the DocuSign attestation and close out by Oct 9.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: playbook-snapshot-2026.md (text)]
